markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the visit occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If members representing the winning team of the 2026 Pro Football Championship has physically travelled to and been present within the geographic boundaries of The White House before Dec 31, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Physical presence within the geographic boundaries of the area is required. Flying over without landing, layovers during which the person remains in the airplane or airport, virtual or remote appearances, future visit plans, or (unless explicitly specified) presence in adjacent international waters or solely within embassy or consulate grounds do NOT constitute a visit. International airports are considered within the boundaries of their host jurisdiction. A visit that began before the specified time period and is ongoing as of its start does not count; however, if the person departs and re-enters the area during the time period, the re-entry constitutes a new visit and does count.
